<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market rally:</strong> The Sensex and Nifty extended their winning streak to four sessions, driven by strong performance in banking and auto stocks alongside positive sentiment from monsoon progress and FII activity.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxQQUNzTHZTd25rakx5LUFrYmVRSFFudGJ2MlhFQ2ZmRjJrQVBDcEdnbld2eWNSS2phS0U5THQ2c2ZvaGgtLU1sMHRtVVRFRW0teWxJMUtheFFxTzhkNTJ1TGZjR25pdkRXYU5VQTcwWldMQlhuSmxtbVpValZYQnlid09NSWkxR2RCM2tFYnRrLVlaTTZ4eVRQSlZJNGY3YzBYZTRleWZlemtaM2RhSG1FRU5NTG1acWZLWnJUelN3?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I24</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>NSE IPO progress:</strong> The National Stock Exchange is set to initiate marketing for its $3 billion (approx. ₹30,000 crore) IPO next week, with a target launch window of September-October.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I15</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Institutional flows:</strong> Despite recent volatility, domestic institutional investors (DIIs) net bought $9 billion in Indian equities during June, offsetting $3 billion in net selling by foreign institutional investors (FIIs).<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I30</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxOLXI0dzhQVXZKZ0prQy1RQVlkejBPT3hZektjZTFZWENLVmg0eUxXcWlZTHBxRGEyaG53UUhKTkNnVUwwd2E1MF8zc2stQlpBMWdaX3JJcXhoc2VZS1BUS3o3YS0xUUkxQVFBWk56R0lVTW1YYzU0QVcyODVGTklGbjBEWkdtSjVsSGptbmJKV1Y0cExnd2kzRlUtOS1BRFFHa2NnVHZKYzN5OWNRbm9ZYXZhbw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I31</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>RBI policy update:</strong> The RBI MPC maintained the repo rate at 5.25% while revising FY27 growth projections to 6.6% and raising inflation expectations to 5.1%.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I32</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>
